note: Locations an archived daily game served that were later removed from locations.json. Replay resolves IDs here; build-daily-schedule.mjs validates against it. Append only.

battle-of-waterloo.clue: Where was the Battle of Waterloo fought in 1815?
battle-of-waterloo.fact: Napoleon's last battle ended the French advance; the Lion's Mound on the battlefield marks the spot where the Prince of Orange was found wounded.

casablanca-morocco.fact: Morocco's largest city is home to the Hassan II Mosque, whose minaret is one of the tallest religious structures in the world.

great-barrier-reef.clue: Where is the world's largest coral reef system?
great-barrier-reef.fact: Stretching over 2,300 kilometers off Australia's coast, it's the largest living structure on Earth and visible from space.

la-rinconada-peru.clue: Where is the highest permanent human settlement on Earth?
la-rinconada-peru.fact: This Peruvian gold-mining town sits above 5,100 meters in the Andes, where the air holds about half the oxygen found at sea level.

mcmurdo-station.clue: Where is the largest research station on the coldest continent?
mcmurdo-station.fact: This US Antarctic base sits on volcanic rock and can swell to over 1,000 people in the austral summer.

point-nemo.clue: Where is the point in the ocean farthest from any land?
point-nemo.fact: Named after Jules Verne's submarine captain, this spot in the South Pacific is so remote that astronauts in orbit are sometimes the closest humans to it.

quito-ecuador.fact: Ecuador's capital sits in an Andean valley almost exactly on the equator, at an elevation of nearly 2,850 meters.

santiago-chile.fact: Chile's capital sits in a valley ringed by the Andes, close enough that snow-capped peaks loom over the skyline.

toronto-canada.fact: Canada's largest city rises beside Lake Ontario and is marked by the CN Tower, once the world's tallest freestanding structure.

brooklyn-us.fact: Brooklyn would be one of the largest cities in the US if it were independent, and it was its own city until it joined New York in 1898.

soweto-za.fact: Soweto is the Johannesburg township where Nelson Mandela and Desmond Tutu both lived on the same street, Vilakazi Street.
